# claudio-gortex — Gortex code-intelligence daemon exposing the MCP Streamable
# its daemon would live/die with the agent. Running Gortex as its own service
# when started with --http-addr (see gortex docs/cli.md). The agent's MCP entry
# therefore points at http://gortex:<port>/mcp.
# curl + ca-certificates: fetch the signed release. git: Gortex reads git
# Install the Gortex binary system-wide so it is on the default PATH
# (/usr/local/bin). GORTEX_NO_PATH=1 skips the shell-rc edit (there is no
# interactive shell here). Pin a version with --build-arg GORTEX_VERSION=vX.Y.Z
ARG GORTEX_VERSION=
if [ -n "${GORTEX_VERSION}" ]; then export GORTEX_VERSION; fi; \
curl -fsSL https://get.gortex.dev \
| GORTEX_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin GORTEX_NO_PATH=1 sh; \
gortex version
# Unprivileged runtime user. Gortex keeps its config and index under $HOME/.gortex
ARG GORTEX_UID=1000
ARG GORTEX_GID=1000
RUN groupadd --gid "${GORTEX_GID}" gortex \
&& useradd --uid "${GORTEX_UID}" --gid "${GORTEX_GID}" --create-home \
--shell /bin/bash gortex \
&& mkdir -p /workspace /home/gortex/.gortex \
&& chown -R gortex:gortex /workspace /home/gortex/.gortex
# NOTE: /home/gortex/.gortex MUST exist here with gortex:gortex ownership. The
# compose service mounts the named volume `gortex-data` at this path. Docker
COPY docker/gortex/entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh
USER gortex:gortex
ENV HOME=/home/gortex
# claudio-gortex container entrypoint.
# Brings up the Gortex daemon so it serves the MCP Streamable HTTP transport at
#   GORTEX_REPO        repository path to index (default /workspace — the same
#   GORTEX_EXTRA_REPOS comma-separated additional repository paths to track.
#   GORTEX_MANIFEST    path to write the index manifest the agent reads at
#                      session start (default /workspace/.gortex-index.json).
#   GORTEX_HTTP_PORT   port for --http-addr (default 7411).
REPO="${GORTEX_REPO:-/workspace}"
PORT="${GORTEX_HTTP_PORT:-7411}"
MANIFEST="${GORTEX_MANIFEST:-/workspace/.gortex-index.json}"
log() { printf '[gortex-entrypoint] %s\n' "$*"; }
gortex daemon stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
# Split GORTEX_EXTRA_REPOS on commas (NOT whitespace): repository paths may
if [ -n "${GORTEX_EXTRA_REPOS:-}" ]; then
IFS=',' read -ra EXTRA_REPOS <<< "$GORTEX_EXTRA_REPOS"
if gortex track "$r"; then
tmp="$(dirname "$MANIFEST")/.gortex-index.$$.tmp"
# Gortex refuses a non-localhost bind without a bearer token (security guard).
# supply a token. Gortex reads $GORTEX_DAEMON_HTTP_TOKEN by default; we also pass
# it explicitly. The agent's mcp.servers gortex entry must send the SAME token as
TOKEN="${GORTEX_DAEMON_HTTP_TOKEN:-${GORTEX_HTTP_TOKEN:-}}"
log "FATAL: GORTEX_DAEMON_HTTP_TOKEN is empty; a non-localhost --http-addr bind"
log "       requires a token. Set GORTEX_HTTP_TOKEN in .env (compose passes it)."
# foreground (see gortex docs/cli.md: --detach only backgrounds the same process).
exec gortex daemon start --http-addr "0.0.0.0:${PORT}" --http-auth-token "$TOKEN"
# Gortex code-intelligence daemon (issue #54, Option B). Opt-in via the
# "gortex" compose profile so the DEFAULT stack is unchanged. Enable either by
# setting CLAUDIO_GORTEX_ENABLED=true in .env (then ./claudio-ctl start adds the
#     docker compose --profile gortex up -d
# It serves the MCP Streamable HTTP transport at http://gortex:7411/mcp on the
# mcp.servers gortex entry points at that URL. It indexes the SAME /workspace
# bind mount the agent uses, so the paths Gortex returns are paths the agent can
# listed in GORTEX_EXTRA_REPOS (see the service below) — the tracked-root set is
gortex:
profiles: ["gortex"]
image: claudio/gortex:${CLAUDIO_TAG:-latest}
dockerfile: docker/gortex/Dockerfile
GORTEX_UID: ${CLAUDIO_UID:-1000}
GORTEX_GID: ${CLAUDIO_GID:-1000}
GORTEX_VERSION: ${GORTEX_VERSION:-}
container_name: claudio-gortex
GORTEX_REPO: /workspace
#   GORTEX_EXTRA_REPOS=/home/briggen/Dev/code/ai/clams,/home/briggen/Dev/code/ai/claudio
# not exist for it, and `gortex track` answers "invalid path". The agent
GORTEX_EXTRA_REPOS: ${GORTEX_EXTRA_REPOS:-}
GORTEX_HTTP_PORT: "7411"
# match the "Authorization: Bearer <token>" header in the agent's gortex
GORTEX_DAEMON_HTTP_TOKEN: ${GORTEX_HTTP_TOKEN:-claudio-gortex-internal-token}

- id: gortex
